clue.text: Muse as priest struggling with Job

indicators.note: a priest struggling is thrown about, so the letters of priest are rearranged

parts.note: a job is a chore, a task to be done

explanation.surface: A cleric wrestles with some task, as if seeking inspiration from the Muses.
explanation.definitionFit: Terpsichore is the Greek Muse of dance, one of the nine Muses.

clue.text: Wounded marksman may have this process to resolve problem

definitions.meaning: an injured sharpshooter would have difficulty firing his gun
systematic diagnosis and fixing of faults

explanation.surface: An injured sniper struggles, while someone tries to fix a fault.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as TROUBLE SHOOTING, the first reading describes the wounded marksman's difficulty aiming.
explanation.definitionFit: Fault-finding work that tracks down and fixes the cause of a problem is called this.

clue.text: Puzzle can be hell without a starting point

indicators.note: the word for hell loses its opening letter, so its start is cut off

parts.note: Erebus is the dark underworld of Greek myth, a version of hell

explanation.surface: A puzzle can be hellish if you have no idea where to begin.
explanation.definitionFit: A picture puzzle in which images and letters stand for words is this kind of puzzle.

clue.text: Bird coming from mire swimming in salt water

indicators.note: the jumbled letters sit inside the word for salt water

parts.note: the sea is salt water

indicators.note: letters of mire are swimming about, so mixed up

explanation.surface: A bird emerges from a swamp and goes for a swim in the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The seriema is a long-legged South American bird of the grasslands.

clue.text: Plant one of the others in the coven?

definitions.meaning: a tropical climbing bean with stinging hairs on its pods

definitions.text: one of the others in the coven?
definitions.meaning: a fellow member of a witches' gathering

explanation.surface: A sorcerer asks which herb to grow, or which fellow sorceress, in the coven.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as CO-WITCH, a co-worker among witches; the question mark flags the invented word.
explanation.definitionFit: Cowitch, or cowhage, is a leguminous vine whose pods carry itching bristles.

clue.text: Sheep beginning to go down, feeble — there may still be affection for such

definitions.text: there may still be affection for such

indicators.note: in a down entry, the word's first letter drops to the bottom

parts.note: a fold is a flock of sheep, or their pen
a feeble excuse is a lame one

explanation.surface: A sheep starts to collapse, weak, yet someone still feels fondness for it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beginning to go down' moves F, the start of FOLD, to its end, giving OLDF.
explanation.definitionFit: A former sweetheart is someone for whom lingering fondness may remain.

clue.text: Somehow with regret he'd had to relinquish "'R"

definitions.text: Somehow with regret he'd had to relinquish "'R

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters of the phrase are arranged in some other order
giving up the letter R means it is taken away from the jumbled pool

parts.note: R stands for Rex, the king's title

explanation.surface: A man regretfully had to give up his royal R, the Rex after his name.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove R from WITHREGRETHEDHAD and rearrange the rest. The whole clue is the definition: the king abdicated in 1936, giving up R for Rex.
explanation.definitionFit: This British king abdicated in 1936 to marry Wallis Simpson, giving up his royal title.

clue.text: Injured soldier finally escaping with no desire to fight?

indicators.note: that letter escapes, so it is removed from the word for injured

parts.note: an injured face may be scarred

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of soldier

explanation.surface: A wounded soldier finally flees the battle, with no appetite for combat.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone afraid has no wish to do battle, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Enthusiasm not so easy without leader, you'd say?

indicators.note: the word loses its first letter, its leader
you'd say signals that the word is judged by how it is spoken, not spelt

parts.note: something less easy is harder

explanation.surface: Enthusiasm wanes when things get tougher and nobody leads.
explanation.walkthrough: In a non-rhotic accent HARDER and HARDOUR sound alike; 'without leader' then drops the H.
explanation.definitionFit: Ardour is passionate zeal or keenness, a synonym of enthusiasm.

clue.text: Opener of window used in plunder into saloon?

definitions.text: Opener of window used in plunder into saloon?

indicators.note: that combination goes into the word for a saloon

parts.note: a saloon is a type of car

indicators.note: the letter is used inside the verb for plunder

parts.note: to plunder is to rob

indicators.note: the opener of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A burglar's tool forces a window open to steal from a saloon car.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition: a jemmy for prising open a car window.
explanation.definitionFit: A thieves' iron bar levers open windows and doors in break-ins.

clue.text: Bereaved man gets fatter without old wife

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the wider word goes around the letters

parts.note: fatter means wider

explanation.surface: A grieving man puts on weight now that his late wife is gone.
explanation.definitionFit: A man whose spouse has died is called this.

clue.text: Men returning by vehicle check revealed to be most sturdy

indicators.note: returning means the letters are read backwards

parts.note: OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers or men
a bus is a vehicle
a test is a check

explanation.surface: Soldiers coming back by coach undergo a check to find the toughest.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of robust means strongest or hardiest.

clue.text: Tragic king losing energy gets to die slowly

indicators.note: losing removes a letter from the king's name

parts.note: King Lear is Shakespeare's tragic king
E is the symbol for energy
to go is to die, as in pass away

explanation.surface: A doomed monarch, his strength fading, comes to a slow death.
explanation.definitionFit: As a musical direction, largo means at a slow and broad tempo.

clue.text: To be paid pounds for a fight

parts.note: money owed is due
L stands for pounds, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Someone is paid money in return for a bout of fighting.
explanation.definitionFit: A duel is a formal combat between two people.

clue.text: The car to me is mysterious — this is just one instrument

indicators.note: a mysterious arrangement is puzzling, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone baffled by their car finds even one dial on the dashboard confusing.
explanation.definitionFit: A rev counter on a dashboard is one such instrument, measuring engine speed.

clue.text: BBC boss spotted in adult performing club

indicators.note: the boss is spotted inside the word for adult

parts.note: blue means adult, as in risque material
DG is the Director-General, head of the BBC
on means performing, as on stage

explanation.surface: The BBC's chief is caught at an adult show in a nightclub.
explanation.walkthrough: A blue joke or film is adult in the sense of smutty.
explanation.definitionFit: A bludgeon is a heavy cudgel, a club used as a weapon.

clue.text: Mineral lets delicate little person keep healthy

indicators.note: keep means hold inside, so the fairy holds the word for healthy

parts.note: a sprite is an elf or fairy
hale means healthy

explanation.surface: A mineral allows a fragile little being to stay well.
explanation.definitionFit: Sphalerite is zinc blende, the chief ore of zinc.

clue.text: Temper evident in little son time and again

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son
repeatedly means often

explanation.surface: A small boy repeatedly shows a bad temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Temper' is a verb here, to moderate, not a fit of anger.
explanation.definitionFit: To temper something is to moderate or tone it down.

clue.text: Chemical engineers needing time with conservationists

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
an age is a period of time
NT is the National Trust, a British heritage body

explanation.surface: Chemical engineers need time to work alongside green campaigners.
explanation.definitionFit: A reagent is a substance used to produce a chemical reaction.

clue.text: Sweet as source of tummy upset

indicators.note: source of picks the first letter of tummy

parts.note: to upset someone is to ruffle them

explanation.surface: A sweet treat turns out to be the cause of an upset stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: A chocolate truffle is a confection, a type of sweet.

clue.text: Light support

definitions.meaning: a ray or shaft of light
a horizontal timber or girder carrying a load

explanation.walkthrough: Read as one phrase it sounds like a lightweight prop.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word names both a ray of radiance and a structural girder.

clue.text: Foreign character covered in horse muck

indicators.note: the letter is covered by, so put inside, the word for horse

parts.note: a mare is a female horse
nu is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A strange figure is found covered in horse dung.
explanation.definitionFit: Muck is farmyard dung used as fertiliser.

clue.text: One trapped in car in water inlet

indicators.note: the numeral is trapped inside the name of the car

parts.note: a Ford is a make of car
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone is stuck in a car that has plunged into a sea inlet.
explanation.definitionFit: A long narrow sea inlet between cliffs, as in Norway; a variant spelling of fjord.

clue.text: An academic, university lecturer at institute held in high regard

indicators.note: the academic holds the other pieces inside

parts.note: a don is a university teacher

explanation.surface: A university academic and lecturer at an institute is greatly esteemed.
explanation.definitionFit: Adulation is excessive admiration or praise.

clue.text: More beautiful female sent out to provide help in laundry

indicators.note: the letter is sent out, so removed

parts.note: fairer means more beautiful

explanation.surface: A prettier woman is dismissed to go and help with the washing.
explanation.definitionFit: A clothes horse or rack for drying washing is a useful aid in the laundry.

clue.text: Effeminate English subject, terribly nice being drunk

indicators.note: the jumbled letters are drunk, so swallowed inside the school subject

parts.note: PE, physical education, is a school subject

indicators.note: terribly signals that the letters of nice are jumbled

explanation.surface: An unmanly Englishman, subject to drink, is being dreadfully pleasant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being drunk' looks like intoxication but means swallowed, the school subject taking the jumbled word in.
explanation.definitionFit: Epicene describes something with characteristics of both sexes, or effeminate.

clue.text: More distant relation, first in reunion to be hugged

indicators.note: the letter is hugged, so placed inside the relation

parts.note: a father is a relation

indicators.note: first in picks the opening letter of reunion

explanation.surface: A distant relative, first at the family reunion, gets a hug.
explanation.definitionFit: The comparative of far means at a greater distance.

clue.text: Disappeared, as ET had done once

definitions.meaning: went into hiding, like a fox in its den
the alien in the film travelled to our planet

explanation.walkthrough: The idiom means hidden away, while literally the film's alien had journeyed to our world.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom from hunting for a fox reaching its den, so vanished into hiding.
